days.title: Every morning, Every night
days.message: Good morning. For the next ten days, Every morning starts with something from me. The first gift is the one you'll get the most of: I'm there at the start of your day, through it, and at the end of it.
days.gift: Every morning, a call at the time you choose. Every night, a voice note before you sleep. Redeem this once to tell me your call time.

days.title: A book of three coupons
days.message: Some gifts are just a day. These three are for whenever you need them.
days.gift: One hour of me, any time, no questions asked. One argument you win, no debate. One 'drop everything' call: if you need me, I come. They never expire. When you use one, tell me which.

days.title: A handwritten letter, delivered by me
days.message: There are things I say quickly that deserve to be said slowly. So I wrote them down.
days.gift: Tell me when you're home and I'll bring the letter to your door myself.

days.title: Teach me something you love
days.message: I want to understand the things that make you light up.
days.gift: One hour where you teach me anything you love. Tell me anything you would like me to think about and I give it my full attention.

days.title: Take me to your favourite place
days.message: I know the places we go together. I want to see the ones that were yours before me or the ones you visit when I'm not there with you.
days.gift: Take me anywhere that matters to you and tell me why. I'll drive, you lead.

days.title: Ten 'open when' letters
days.message: I can't always be there the moment you need me. These can.
days.gift: Ten sealed envelopes, each marked for a moment: open when you're sad, when you miss me, when you can't sleep, and more. Tell me when you're home and I'll bring them over.

days.title: A shopping day, your way
days.message: Today we go wherever you want to go, for as long as you want.
days.gift: Pick the shops, the market, the mall, anywhere. Pony Porter is with you the whole way: no complaints, no 'I'm tired', no 'are we done yet'. Just tell me where to drive.

days.title: An afternoon just for you
days.message: You look after everyone. Today your Lucky Kolha looks after you.
days.gift: A spa or salon session of your choice. I book it, you enjoy!

days.title: A yes afternoon
days.message: Tomorrow is your day. Today, for two hours, the answer is always yes.
days.gift: For two hours, I will say yes to anything "reasonable" you ask for.

days.title: A treasure hunt across the city
days.message: Happy birthday, Mau, my Love! Today, you have something to find.
days.gift: A trail of clues through places that matter to us, with something waiting at the end. Your first clue is on its way.
